content_sections.heading: Integral University Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 13/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Integral University notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Tech. / M.Tech. / MCA degree from a recognized Institution / University Experience: Relevant experience will be preferred. Fresher's may also apply. Other conditions: Basic knowledge of MS Excel: data handling, sorting, filtering, formulas, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP Basic SQL: SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY and data filtering Basic data visualization and dashboard creation in Power BI / Tableau Data analysis (cleaning, interpretation, reporting, trends) and basic statistics (averages, percentages) Ability to draft clear, grammatically correct and professional emails Good analytical thinking, problem-solving, attention to detail and willingness to learn Desirable: Relevant experience will be preferred Basic knowledge of Python (Pandas, NumPy) will be an added advantage

content_sections.heading: How Will Integral University Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Aptitude Test English Assessment Professional Email Writing Test Technical Assessment / Interview Aptitude Test: logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude and analytical ability English Assessment: grammar, vocabulary, comprehension and written English Professional Email Writing Test: draft a sample professional email based on a given situation Technical Assessment / Interview: basic data analytics knowledge and relevant technical skills Only short listed candidates will be informed for appearing in the interview
